import os
program_dir=os.path.join(base,'programs'); os.makedirs(program_dir,exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    """Complete horizontal one-cell gaps and project their colors upward."""
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0]) if h else 0
    sources={}
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        for c in range(1,w-1):
            if row[c] != 0:
                continue
            left=c-1
            while left>=0 and row[left]==0: left-=1
            right=c+1
            while right<w and row[right]==0: right+=1
            if left>=0 and right<w and row[left]==row[right]!=0:
                sources.setdefault(c,[]).append((r,row[left]))
    for c, items in sources.items():
        items.sort()
        for i,(r,color) in enumerate(items):
            start=0 if i==0 else items[i-1][0]+1
            # This source paints upward, ending immediately below the prior source.
            for rr in range(start,r+1):
                out[rr][c]=color
    return out
'''
